GOODBYE.notes: Approximate: open hand waves side to side. Best-effort, not verified by an ASL signer -- flag for review.

MORE.notes: Approximate: pinched (flat-O) fingertips of both hands tap together. Best-effort, not verified by an ASL signer -- flag for review.

NEED.notes: Approximate: bent (X-like) hand moves downward. Best-effort, not verified by an ASL signer -- flag for review.

UNDERSTAND.notes: Approximate: index finger flicks upward near the forehead/temple. Best-effort, not verified by an ASL signer -- flag for review.

KNOW.notes: Approximate: flat hand taps near the forehead/temple. Best-effort, not verified by an ASL signer -- flag for review.

WAIT.notes: Approximate: both open hands, fingers wiggling, held forward. Best-effort, not verified by an ASL signer -- flag for review.

STOP.notes: Approximate: flat hand chops down onto the other open palm. Best-effort, not verified by an ASL signer -- flag for review.

FINISH.notes: Approximate: both open 5-hands twist outward from the wrists. Best-effort, not verified by an ASL signer -- flag for review.

HOT.notes: Approximate: claw hand near the mouth twists away sharply. Best-effort, not verified by an ASL signer -- flag for review.

COLD.notes: Approximate: both fists shiver/shake close to the body. Best-effort, not verified by an ASL signer -- flag for review.

SICK.notes: Approximate: middle-finger-bent hand touches the forehead. Best-effort, not verified by an ASL signer -- flag for review.

BATHROOM.notes: Approximate: T-handshape (fist, thumb between index/middle) shakes side to side. Best-effort, not verified by an ASL signer -- flag for review.

DRINK.notes: Approximate: C-handshape tips toward the mouth like a cup. Best-effort, not verified by an ASL signer -- flag for review.

WORK.notes: Approximate: fist taps down on top of the other fist, twice. Best-effort, not verified by an ASL signer -- flag for review.

HOME.notes: Approximate: flat-O hand taps near the cheek/mouth then near the ear. Best-effort, not verified by an ASL signer -- flag for review.

WHO.notes: Approximate: index finger circles near the chin/lips. Best-effort, not verified by an ASL signer -- flag for review.

WHY.notes: Approximate: fingers touch the forehead then pull down into a Y-handshape. Best-effort, not verified by an ASL signer -- flag for review.

WHEN.notes: Approximate: index finger of one hand circles around the index finger of the other, then they touch. Best-effort, not verified by an ASL signer -- flag for review.

NICE.notes: Approximate: flat hand slides forward across the other palm. Best-effort, not verified by an ASL signer -- flag for review.

HAPPY.notes: Approximate: flat hand pats upward on chest, repeated. Best-effort, not verified by an ASL signer -- flag for review.

WANT.notes: Approximate: claw-shaped hands pull toward the body. Best-effort, not verified by an ASL signer -- flag for review.

EAT.notes: Approximate: pinched (O-shape) fingers tap toward the mouth, repeated. Best-effort, not verified by an ASL signer -- flag for review.

LIKE.notes: Approximate: thumb and middle finger touch chest then pull away and open. Best-effort, not verified by an ASL signer -- flag for review.

FRIEND.notes: Approximate: hooked index fingers link together, twist. Best-effort, not verified by an ASL signer -- flag for review.

WATER.notes: Approximate: W-handshape (index, middle, ring extended) taps near the chin. Best-effort, not verified by an ASL signer -- flag for review.

MOTHER.notes: Approximate: open 5-hand, thumb taps near the chin. Best-effort, not verified by an ASL signer -- flag for review.

FATHER.notes: Approximate: open 5-hand, thumb taps near the forehead. Best-effort, not verified by an ASL signer -- flag for review.

SAD.notes: Approximate: open hand slides downward in front of the face. Best-effort, not verified by an ASL signer -- flag for review.

TIRED.notes: Approximate: bent (claw) hands drop slightly from the chest. Best-effort, not verified by an ASL signer -- flag for review.

HUNGRY.notes: Approximate: C-shaped hand slides down the chest. Best-effort, not verified by an ASL signer -- flag for review.

AGAIN.notes: Approximate: bent hand taps into the other open palm. Best-effort, not verified by an ASL signer -- flag for review.

FINE.notes: Approximate: thumbs-up handshape held at the chest. Best-effort, not verified by an ASL signer -- flag for review.

DEAF.notes: Approximate: index finger moves from near the ear to near the chin. Best-effort, not verified by an ASL signer -- flag for review.

A.notes: Closed fist, thumb resting alongside index finger.

B.notes: Flat hand, fingers up, thumb folded across palm.

C.notes: Curved hand like holding a cup.

D.notes: Index up, other fingers curled touching thumb.

E.notes: All fingertips curled down to thumb.

F.notes: Index and thumb form a circle; other fingers extended.

H.notes: Index and middle extended together, sideways.

J.notes: Like I with a J-motion trace. Motion approximated by wrist rotation.

K.notes: Index and middle up in a V, thumb between them.

L.notes: Index up, thumb perpendicular — the L-shape.

O.notes: Fingers curled to touch thumb forming an O.

R.notes: Index and middle crossed (approximated — no lateral spread in placeholder rig).

S.notes: Fist with thumb wrapped across the front of fingers.

T.notes: Fist with thumb tucked between index and middle finger.

V.notes: Index and middle up in a V (spread approximated).

Y.notes: Pinky and thumb out, others closed.

Z.notes: Index up, traces a Z (approximated with wrist wag).

HELLO.notes: Flat B-hand at temple, sweeps outward like a salute.

YES.notes: S-hand nods up and down like a head nod.

SORRY.notes: S-hand circles on chest. R_palm_deg approximates the circular motion as a wrist roll (position offsets are not applied during playback -- see docs/RETARGETING.md).

HELP.notes: One hand thumb-up on flat other palm, lift up. R_palm_deg approximates the lift as a wrist tilt (position offsets are not applied during playback -- see docs/RETARGETING.md).

I-LOVE-YOU.notes: The iconic ILY handshape: thumb, index, and pinky extended; middle and ring folded down. Held steady, wrist rotates slightly outward to present the hand.

GOOD.notes: Flat hand from chin down onto other palm.

BAD.notes: Flat hand from chin, flip palm down, move away.

ME.notes: Index finger points to own chest. R_palm_deg added so the wrist actually rotates the pointing direction back toward her body (position offsets are not applied during playback -- see docs/RETARGETING.md -- so a real rotation is required, not just a moved pivot). Tuned approximately against the current ARM_LIFT pose; revisit if the arm-lift geometry changes.

YOU.notes: Index finger points forward (to addressee). R_palm_deg added so the wrist actually rotates the pointing direction outward from her body (position offsets are not applied during playback -- see docs/RETARGETING.md -- so a real rotation is required, not just a moved pivot). Tuned approximately against the current ARM_LIFT pose; revisit if the arm-lift geometry changes.

WHAT.notes: Both flat hands, palms up, shake side to side.

WHERE.notes: Index finger wagging side to side.

NAME.notes: Two-handed: H-hand of dominant hand taps H-hand of the other, twice. R_palm_deg approximates the tap as a small wrist dip (position offsets are not applied during playback -- see docs/RETARGETING.md).
